text:
anya_cs: Heads-up: new customer 'lumen' seeing 429s during onboarding when many users open the web app after SSO. Spike only in eu-central-1.

sam_eng: Errors and sample payload? 429s at /v1/preflight or generation?

anya_cs: Preflight. Snip: `HTTP 429 {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","scope":"preflight","retry_after":1}`. They said ~150 concurrent tab opens during their org-wide rollout.

pat_oncall: Likely token refresh + SDK init fanout. What SDK version? Any intermediate proxy?

anya_cs: Browser SDK v0.10.1. They mint ephemeral tokens on their backend with ttl=30s. No custom proxy reported, but Cloudflare in front of their backend.

sam_eng: TTL=30s is risky for big rollouts. Suggest: increase TTL >=60s, upgrade SDK to 0.10.4 (has preflight dedupe), and enable client-side preflight coalescing. Quick test value: PREFLIGHT_DEDUP_WINDOW_MS=500.

pat_oncall: Also ask them to add jitter to token refresh and avoid fetching tokens synchronously on page load for all tabs. A short-term workaround: queue preflight requests on the client and cap concurrency to 8.

anya_cs: I sent repro instructions and a small headless repro script. They tested with TTL=90s + PREFLIGHT_DEDUP_WINDOW_MS=500 and reported no 429s after a 20-minute ramp. Monitoring for 1h.

deploy-bot: deploy: sdk@0.10.4 rolled to canary (job #4490).

sam_eng: Good. Can we add a KB: "Onboarding rollouts: avoid short ephemeral TTLs, enable preflight dedupe, and cap client preflight concurrency". Also product should consider safer defaults in next SDK.

pat_oncall: I'll update the incident board and change account status from at-risk to monitoring if the 1h window is clean.

anya_cs: Thanks team — customer will schedule a gradual org rollout and use the recommended settings. :white_check_mark:
